minecraftLogin.title: Log in with game account
minecraftLogin.description: Enter the game account you use on the HydCraft server. This does not verify a premium Minecraft account. It only recognizes game accounts that were registered within HydCraft and have logged in before. Accounts registered after Season 6 began on February 17, 2022 can be bound. If you have not registered within HydCraft and logged in before, binding is not possible.

minecraftRegister.title: Register with game account
minecraftRegister.description: Enter the game account you use on the HydCraft server. After verification succeeds, a Hydroline ID will be registered automatically. This does not verify a premium Minecraft account. It only recognizes game accounts that were registered within HydCraft and have logged in before. Accounts registered after Season 6 began on February 17, 2022 can be bound. If you have not registered within HydCraft and logged in before, binding is not possible.
